svg.title: GitHub Copilot Usage Lens
svg.desc: A coffee mug with a handle holds a shared credit pool. Blue liquid and rising usage bars are brought into focus by a magnifying lens. In an eight-second loop, the liquid level rises and falls while the lens scans the bars. Motion stops when reduced motion is requested. The name is drawn as vector outlines in Mona Sans. The GitHub Copilot icon sits before the product name, above Usage Lens.
